rules.description: Label color must be a valid 3 or 6 character hex color code
Label color is normalized to lowercase 6-char hex with # prefix
DeleteLabel verifies label belongs to the specified repo before deleting
DeleteLabel cascades to remove issue_label associations and related comments
rules.action: Delete from issue_label and comment tables where label_id matches

rules.description: UpdateLabel recalculates num_issues and num_closed_issues via subqueries
rules.action: Set num_issues = count(*) from issue_label, num_closed_issues = count where issue.is_closed

rules.description: Repo search respects private visibility based on authentication
rules.condition: User is signed in and private param is not explicitly false
rules.action: Include private repos user has access to

rules.description: Repo search validates sort mode against allowed values
rules.action: Return 422 with invalid sort mode error

rules.description: Repository creation applies ForcePrivate setting override
rules.action: Repository is always created as private regardless of user input

rules.description: CreateUserRepo validates readme template exists when auto_init is true
rules.condition: opt.AutoInit && len(opt.Readme) > 0 && readme not in available list

rules.description: Generate repo requires admin or org membership to create for other users
rules.condition: Target owner is different from doer and doer is not admin
rules.action: Return 403 if target is not org, or check org create permission

rules.description: Generate repo requires at least one template option to be selected
rules.condition: No template items selected (all booleans false)
rules.code_snippet: return gro.GitContent || gro.Topics || gro.GitHooks || gro.Webhooks || gro.Avatar || gro.IssueLabels || gro.ProtectedBranch

rules.description: Org repo creation requires user to have create permission in org
rules.condition: User is not admin and cannot create org repo
